scope: Mars regional ice-investigation candidates; no landing or extractability approval
pool_rule: All six objective descriptors and TI/elevation finite, both SWIM depth-zone consistency descriptors >0, not old eight ice-candidate cells and not inside old project boxes. Sign>0 is an exploration choice, not calibrated presence/quantity or a mission threshold.
reference_population: all exploratory-pool cells in this run, not all potential Mars landing sites
selection_for_review: union of front extremes and geographically separated examples; 5-degree rectangular display-diversity exclusion, not fixed km or engineering buffer; deliberately includes >=51N candidates, without marking prior-site audit as passed
contexts_not_monotonic_objectives: MCS adjusted temperature medians, contrast and populated-bin counts
dust seasonal profiles, maxima and reliability

full_data_accounting.terrain: existing MOLA slope/relief plus newly extracted absolute elevation; regional means do not resolve hazards
full_data_accounting.thermal: TI kept separate from temperature; no preferred TI assumed
full_data_accounting.water_ice: both SWIM 2 depth ranges included; they share data and are not independent confirmations; cannot estimate ice content/depth
full_data_accounting.dust: MY34 and MY35 mean/p95/max/four Ls seasons/provider reliability and 610Pa-normalized context; no local wind/deposition/pressure inferred
full_data_accounting.temperature: MCS MY29–36 at native 5deg 03/15 LTST, model time-adjusted and QA/count/uncertainty absent; context only, no favourable ranking
full_data_accounting.MEDA: 159418 rover-local records at already-known Jezero, no quality-qualified rows in existing report; inventoried but not transplanted to candidates
full_data_accounting.unavailable: local pressure/wind, material strength, mineralogy, independent ice truth, instrument-specific thresholds, local hazard and extraction readiness remain unknown

limits: No novelty clearance: all candidates require bounded footprint and same-purpose literature audit.
The front depends on declared objectives and incomplete available products; non-dominated does not mean mission-optimal.
MOLA terrain variables and the two SWIM layers are correlated/shared-source evidence; variable count is not independent evidence count.
5deg MCS and 3deg reconstructed dust support are retained; interpolated 0.5deg columns do not increase native resolution.
Different product periods and footprints do not constitute one contemporaneous controlled experiment.
